Portland General Electric Company Second Revision of Sheet No. 115-1
P.U.C. Oregon No. E-19 Canceling First Revision of Sheet No. 115-1
SCHEDULE 115
LOW-INCOME ASSISTANCE
PURPOSE
The purpose of this rate schedule is to implement the low-income bill payment assistance
provisions in accordance with ORS 757.612(7)(b).
APPLICABLE
To all Retail Electricity Customers, including Customers receiving electricity from other sources
and Customers who do not purchase distribution services from PGE per ORS 757.612(8), except
those Customers explicitly exempted.
ADJUSTMENT RATES
The applicable Adjustment Rates are listed below. As specified in ORS 757.698(1)(c) and
amended by House Bill 3792 (2025), Customers will not be required to pay more than $1,000 per
month per Site for low-income bill payment assistance. Sites are defined in Rule B and F of this (C)
tariff.
Schedules Adjustment Rate
(I)
7 $1.24 per month
All other Schedules, 0.138¢ per kWh
including DSIs for the first 724,638 kWh
SPECIAL CONDITION
1. On a monthly basis, on or before the last day of the month, the Company will forward an
amount to the Oregon Housing and Community Services Department (OHCS) based on
billings to Customers for the previous month less a reserve for uncollectible amounts.
Advice No. 26-02
Issued January 28, 2026 Effective for service
Angelica Espinosa, Senior Vice President on and after April 1, 2026
